add-background-image-artifact.title: Add Background Image Artifact to PDF Page
add-background-image-artifact.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a BackgroundArtifact from an image stream, add it to the first page, and save the updated document.

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark__v4.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Watermark to All PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark__v4.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a WatermarkArtifact with styled, semi‑transparent text, attach it to every page, and save the watermarked document.

extract-watermark-texts-to-csv.title: Extract Watermark Texts from PDF Page to CSV
extract-watermark-texts-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF, reads all WatermarkArtifact texts from the first page, and writes them into a CSV file.

list-watermark-artifact-rectangles-page-.title: List Watermark Artifact Rectangles on PDF Page 2
list-watermark-artifact-rectangles-page-.description: The example loads a PDF, verifies that a second page exists, enumerates WatermarkArtifact objects on that page, and writes each artifact's rectangle coordinates to a text file.

set-watermark-opacity-first-page.title: Set Watermark Opacity on First PDF Page
set-watermark-opacity-first-page.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over WatermarkArtifact objects on the first page, sets their opacity to 0.5, and saves the modified document.

extract-background-images-from-pdf-page.title: Extract Background Images from PDF Page
extract-background-images-from-pdf-page.description: Loads a PDF, accesses page three, iterates its artifacts, extracts any BackgroundArtifact images, and saves them as PNG files to a specified folder.

add-multiple-watermark-artifacts-to-pdf-.title: Add Multiple Watermark Artifacts to a PDF Page
add-multiple-watermark-artifacts-to-pdf-.description: The example loads a PDF, accesses page five, adds two WatermarkArtifact objects to the page's ArtifactCollection, and saves the modified document.

add-footer-pagination-artifact.title: Add Footer Pagination Artifact to PDF Page
add-footer-pagination-artifact.description: Loads a PDF, creates a pagination footer artifact containing the page number, adds it to page six, and saves the modified document.

count-background-artifacts-per-pdf-page.title: Count Background Artifacts per PDF Page
count-background-artifacts-per-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through its pages, counting BackgroundArtifact objects on each page, and writing a summary to a text file.

add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages__v3.title: Add Bates Numbering to PDF Pages
add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages__v3.description: Shows how to load a PDF, generate sequential Bates numbers, apply them as TextStamp artifacts on each page, and save the updated document.

add-bates-numbering-to-pdf.title: Add Bates Numbering to PDF Pages
add-bates-numbering-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying a batch of custom Bates numbering artifacts to each page using TextFragment, and saving the modified document.

remove-bates-numbering-artifacts.title: Remove Bates Numbering Artifacts from PDF
remove-bates-numbering-artifacts.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page's artifact collection, delete any Bates numbering artifacts, and save the cleaned document.

export-page2-artifact-rectangles-to-csv.title: Export Page 2 Artifact Rectangles to CSV
export-page2-artifact-rectangles-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF, extracts the rectangle bounds of all artifacts on the second page, and writes them to a CSV file.

replace-page-background-image.title: Replace Background Image of a PDF Page
replace-page-background-image.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate or create a BackgroundArtifact on page two, replace its background image with a new image, and save the updated document.

add-rotated-watermark-artifact-to-pdf-pa.title: Add Rotated Watermark Artifact to PDF Page
add-rotated-watermark-artifact-to-pdf-pa.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a WatermarkArtifact with a 45° rotation, adding it to the third page, and saving the updated document.

export-page7-background-artifact-images-.title: Export Background Artifact Image Names from Page 7 to CSV
export-page7-background-artifact-images-.description: Loads a PDF, extracts BackgroundArtifact objects from the seventh page, and writes their internal image names to a CSV file.

count-pdf-pagination-artifacts.title: Count PDF Pagination Artifacts and Save to JSON
count-pdf-pagination-artifacts.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, counts the total number of pages (pagination artifacts), and writes the count to a JSON file.

extract-artifact-subtypes-page9-csv.title: Extract Artifact Subtypes from PDF Page 9 to CSV
extract-artifact-subtypes-page9-csv.description: Loads a PDF, accesses the ninth page, iterates through its artifacts, and writes each artifact's Subtype to a CSV file.

count-watermark-artifacts-per-page.title: Count WatermarkArtifacts per PDF Page and Generate Report
count-watermark-artifacts-per-page.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, counts the WatermarkArtifact objects using LINQ, and writes a summary report to a text file.
